outputs.explanation: The figure shows cryo-EM density maps and atomic models of the 48S initiation complex (panels A–C, overview maps; D–G, IRES domain views; H–K, interaction close-ups). None of the panels are quantitative plots, and no statistical significance symbols (asterisks, n.s., etc.) appear on the images or are mentioned in the caption, so the significance-level-definition check does not apply.
